name: Button
summary: A control that starts an action. Pill-shaped buttons, with a solid primary and an outlined secondary.

anatomy.purpose: The pill-shaped hit area. Minimum 44px tall on touch screens.
Verb-first text, 1 to 3 words. Describes the result, not the click.
Optional icon before the label. Decorative; the label carries the meaning.
Replaces the icon while an action runs. Keep the label and width so the layout does not jump.

variants.name: Solid (primary)
variants.use: The one main action on a screen.

variants.name: Outline (secondary)
variants.use: Supporting actions next to a primary.

variants.name: Text (tertiary)
variants.use: Low-emphasis actions such as Cancel or Learn more.

variants.name: Destructive
variants.use: Delete or remove actions. Pair with a confirmation.

contentLimits.label: name the object, for example Delete project

whenToUse: The person triggers an action on the current page: save, send, add, delete.
A form needs a submit control.
whenNotToUse: The control moves to another page: use a link instead.
A choice among options: use radio buttons, a toggle or a segmented control.
Several equal-weight actions: use a menu.

keyboard: Tab reaches it in reading order.
accessibility.focus: Always show a visible focus ring with 3:1 contrast against its surroundings. Do not remove the outline.
notes: Use a real <button>, not a div.
Disabled state still needs 3:1 for the outline if it must be seen; explain why it is disabled nearby.
Touch targets are at least 44x44px (WCAG 2.2 minimum is 24x24).
Hover styles apply to desktop only. On mobile-only products, design pressed and focus states instead.

code.html:
<button class="btn btn--solid" type="button">Save changes</button>
<button class="btn btn--outline" type="button">Preview</button>
<button class="btn btn--text" type="button">Cancel</button>
